blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Through the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) public-private partnership concession agreement, the operational control of more than 2,100 closed-circuit television (CCTV) cameras at the country’s main gateway was formally turned over to the New Naia Infra Corp. (NNIC). The agreement between the Department of Transportation (DOTr), the Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA), and the private concessionaire granted NNIC the authority to operate and maintain the airport for 15 years. It is also extendable by 10 years. As parts of its operations and maintenance responsibilities, the MIAA officially handed over the operational control of the airport’s CCTVs to the […]...
